scope: Read-only substantive academic scope review of consolidated report; no source edits or engine runs.

critical_corrections.quoted_claim: Raw features are prepared before splitting, making their own causality part of the contract.
critical_corrections.reason: Confuses outer raw-data splitting with inner-fold preprocessing. Native outer preparation splits raw data first, then computes features per split. Raw features precede inner-fold shim/scaler refits.
critical_corrections.replacement: Raw features are computed before inner-fold preparation, so their own causality remains part of the contract; outer raw-data splitting still precedes feature construction.
